questions.q: What does the Payables Invoice Aging Report do?
options: Lists unpaid invoices grouped into aging buckets based on how overdue they are
Lists all customer receipts for the period
Reconciles the Balance Sheet to the Income Statement
Schedules Enterprise Scheduler Service jobs
questions.explain: Each unpaid invoice falls into exactly one aging bucket (current, 1-30 days, 31-60, etc.) based on how far past due it is.

questions.q: What might a large "over 90 days" bucket relative to total payables indicate?
options: Nothing of concern; it is always irrelevant
A cash flow problem, a supplier dispute, or a data problem such as an invoice that should have been paid or cancelled
That the company has too much cash on hand
That the General Ledger is misconfigured
questions.explain: A large balance in the oldest aging bucket can point to several different underlying issues, each requiring a different next action.

questions.q: How does the formal Payables Invoice Aging Report relate to the ad hoc OTBI aging analysis built in Chapter 3?
options: They answer completely unrelated questions
They answer a similar underlying question about overdue invoices, but through different tools suited to different purposes (ad hoc vs. formal/scheduled)
The OTBI version replaced the BI Publisher version entirely
Only one of the two can exist in a given Fusion environment
questions.explain: Both address "what's overdue," but the OTBI analysis suits a quick internal check while the BI Publisher report suits formal, often scheduled distribution.

questions.q: What does a Payables-to-Ledger Reconciliation report verify?
options: That all invoices have been approved
That the Payables subledger's totals match the balances actually posted in the General Ledger through Subledger Accounting
That OTBI subject areas are correctly configured
That Smart View is properly installed
questions.explain: This reconciliation ties the subledger's view of what's owed and paid to what landed in the GL, a standard close checkpoint.

questions.q: Besides aging, what is another category of predefined Payables reports mentioned in this lesson?
options: Fixed Asset depreciation schedules
Payment registers, netting reports, and income tax/withholding reports
OTBI dashboard definitions
Smart View Report Packages
questions.explain: Beyond aging, Payables ships reports covering payments issued, netting between business partners, and tax withholding obligations.
